## Changed

- Building GitFrame from source now requires Zig 0.17.1. The prebuilt Linux
  x86_64 and macOS Apple Silicon binaries include the executable.
- Updated the terminal runtime to Chasen v0.1.5 and the UI components to
  Chasen UI v0.1.5. Syntax highlighting uses a Zig 0.17.1-compatible
  revision of flow-syntax.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/hiroaqii/gitframe/compare/v0.1.11...v0.1.12)
